notes: No personal site/CV; built from his self-registered RePEc/IDEAS page (journal articles, plus World Bank PRWPs not later published as journal articles; reports, monthly economic updates, books, AAEA conference papers and pre-2000 WPs skipped). The 2025 WBRO article (Baffes, Nagle, Streifel) was found via a search snippet of the IDEAS page; IDEAS may lack other recent items. Years are IDEAS years. 'Placing the 2006/08 boom' and other older PRWPs kept as working papers because no journal version is listed.
